session control: Launch, message, wake and end fleet sessions.
session control evidence: Read machine-local files about a session.
session control evidence get: Read a session's relay, watcher or diagnostic file.
session control keepalive: Keep an idle session from being ended.
session control keepalive hold: Keep a session alive while it holds no work.
session control keepalive release: Let a held session end when idle again.
session control launch: Preview, start and manage session launches.
session control launch create: Launch a new agent session for a project.
session control launch preview: Show where a session launch would run.
session control launch reconcile: Settle a launch whose outcome is unknown.
session control launch retry: Try a failed session launch again.
session control message acknowledge: Record that you acted on a message.
session control message cancel: Cancel a message that is not yet read.
session control message get: Show one message and who received it.
session control message list: List Fleet messages and their delivery.
session control message preview: Show who a Fleet message would reach.
session control message send: Send a Fleet message to people and sessions.
session control qualification: Open grants that qualify a release.
session control qualification open: Open a short grant to test a release route.
session control session terminate: End a session for good and release its claims.
session control session wake: Resume a stopped session with a message.
session control surface: Turn agent surfaces on or off per machine.
session control surface policy: Turn agent surfaces on or off per machine.
session control surface policy disable: Stop launches on one surface of a machine.
session control surface policy enable: Allow launches again on a machine surface.
session control surface policy list: List machine surfaces that are turned off.
